units.source_text: Pick one protective act and give it a time, a first step, and whatever help it needs.
units.output_text: Work on only one of these acts at a time. Once you've decided on a specific action, determine what you need to do in order to carry it out.

units.source_text: If the act is staying in a motel instead of your old room next time you visit your parents, the first step can be as small as finding out what a night costs.
units.output_text: Perhaps you need to budget some money if you plan to stay at a motel the next time you visit your parents, instead of in your old bedroom.

units.source_text: The hard part is telling your mother, which you can see coming for weeks, so say it out loud once or twice before you call her.
units.output_text: Or you might need to rehearse telling your mother about your decision one or two times.
